combo_label: Pets & Petcare × Disney × The Great Fire of London

entries.clue: Huge long-tailed parrot in scarlet or blue, screeching over the rainforest
The City's great market street, its goldsmiths' shops all consumed
The City's council house, whose stone shell stood when all within was gone
Consulting room where the vet holds morning appointments
Red-haired archer princess at the heart of Pixar's Brave
Tough cushion on the underside of a dog's foot, through which it sweats
Windy warthog who sings of a worry-free life with a meerkat pal
Frozen reindeer whose 'thoughts' his best friend speaks aloud in a silly voice
Street urchin who wins a princess with a lamp and a flying carpet
Plead for scraps at the dinner table with big, soulful eyes
Rendered fat for candles, stored by the barrel in the riverside warehouses
Part of a church west of the crossing; old St Paul's had a huge one
